summary: This clinical trial is testing VCT220 tablets in adults with type 2 diabetes whose blood sugar levels are not well controlled. The study is sponsored by Vincentage Pharma Co., Ltd and aims to enroll 120 participants. During the trial, participants will receive either different doses of the VCT220 drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the real treatment. The status of this trial is Not yet recruiting.
